kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-bgp-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bgp-group-id bgpg-bp1k25cyp26cllath0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBgpGroup

parameters.help_en:
The region where the BGP group resides. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP group. The BGP group must be in the Available state. After you create a BGP group, call DescribeBgpGroups to query the Status value. Wait until the status changes to Available before you delete the BGP group
parameters.help_zh: BGP组ID。目标BGP组必须处于Available稳定状态；新建后请通过DescribeBgpGroups查询Status，待状态变为Available后再删除
parameters.name: bgp_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
